products.notes: Core product: AI-assisted navigation and organization of research documents. Sunsetted June 26, 2025. Features included client-side search, AI-powered recommendations, project organization. Users directed to coordination.network as successor platform.

compare.pricing_model: SaaS subscription (specific tiers unknown, product sunsetted)

flags: Lateral ceased operations on June 26, 2025 and is no longer accepting signups. Users are migrating to coordination.network.
Lateral holds no SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, FedRAMP, or ISO 27017/27018/27701 certifications. Given the sensitivity of research data, the lack of formal certifications is a notable gap.
The privacy policy mentions Google Privacy Shield certification, which was invalidated in 2020, suggesting the policy may not have been recently refreshed.
A Data Processing Agreement is provided, indicating a GDPR-aware legal setup.
No dedicated trust center or security whitepaper is published, so transparency is limited.

The company is transparent about its founders: five named co-founders with a clear division of responsibilities (Martin Karlsson CEO, Felix Groenemeyer CCO, Ben Wilson CSO, Max CTO, Jann Kleen VP Eng).
